caption: The video captures a low sun over a dark, choppy ocean beneath a smooth orange-to-red sky gradient. A bright white sun disc rests directly on the flat horizon, keeping a steady vertical position. Below the sun, a reddish glow reflects softly on the water. The sea surface is in continuous motion, with rolling swells and waves changing shape and position as they roll through the scene. Patches of white foam appear and disappear along the breaking crests, particularly noticeable in the foreground and midground. Glinting highlights flicker on the wave tops as the water undulates, contrasting with the stable sky. The scene focuses on the interplay between the steady sun and the restless ocean.
